digest.component_or_area: review-bot Bedrock provider construction and region configuration
propositions: The review-bot container resolves no AWS region, so building the Bedrock provider fails at client construction before any model call.
Flipping REBAR_LLM_MODEL to bedrock without configuring a region takes the LLM-Review gate down for every landing because the cutover ships with no cross-provider fallback.

The real defect is that pydantic-ai's UserError is not a subclass of rebar's LLMError, so the fail-closed handler does not catch it, and its message names region_name rather than REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION; provider construction should raise LLMConfigError naming the rebar setting.
AWS_REGION alone does not supply a region on the pinned botocore; only AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (or the config file) is resolved, so infra and tests must use AWS_DEFAULT_REGION.

IMDS reachability supplies credentials but never a region because botocore's IMDSRegionProvider is wired only into the smart-defaults path, making region config and the IMDS hop-limit contingency independent concerns.
The missing region also silently no-ops the review bot's CloudWatch voter metrics, and setting the region restores them so eb6e's rollback alarm on VOTER_ERROR can fire.
